exposure: Type of prior uterine surgery (cesarean section, myomectomy, adenomyomectomy)
Timing of uterine rupture (during labor vs. before delivery)
cohort: Cases of uterine rupture recorded over a 5-year period in Japan.
finding: The incidence of uterine rupture in Japan was 0.015%, with scarred uteri experiencing earlier ruptures and ruptures during labor associated with higher rates of hysterectomy, cerebral palsy, and neonatal death.
mod_finding: Among scarred uterine ruptures, neonatal prognosis was poorer in cases following myomectomy or adenomyomectomy compared to those after cesarean section.
gest_age: 30-39 weeks (timing of uterine rupture varied by scar type)
